newsitem.title: RWANDA: More than 40,000 Hutu refugees flee fighting in Zaire.
newsitem.headline: More than 40,000 Hutu refugees flee fighting in Zaire.

text.p: Some 46,000 Rwandan and Burundian Hutu refugees have fled two camps in eastern Zaire where the Zairean army is battling Banyamulenge ethnic Tutsis, a spokesman for the U.N. refugee agency said on Saturday.

Paul Stromberg, spokesman for the U.N. High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) in Zaire's neighbour Rwanda, told Reuters the refugees from Kagunga and Runingo camps in the Zairean town of Uvira had moved to Uvira town, into hills above Uvira and surrounding banana plantations. Others had vanished.
